description.value: A cross-sectional fMRI and VBM study compared frequent cannabis users with non-users during hippocampus-dependent associative memory.

spans.text: The purpose of the current study is to provide a comprehensive assessment of potential sustained effects of cannabis on hippocampus-dependent associative memory function.

source_definition.value: Experimental task condition: associative learning (AL), single-picture classification (SC), or retrieval (RE).

spans.text: First, an associative learning task (AL) is conducted which requires subjects to establish a meaningful connection between two pictures and to memorize the combination. In the next task, single pictures have to be classified (SC) which serves as a control task. Finally, in the retrieval task (RE) subjects have to recognize specific combinations previously presented during associative learning.
